title: slice run checks --repo against the origin remote
body:
Outcome: krn slice run refuses (64) at the base stage, before any worktree or claim, a --repo that does not name the origin remote's owner/repo, instead of storing it in the journal and failing at the pr stage.
Evidence: #208 (t-vxshve4): --repo korneliuszburian/krn passed base, worktree and claim; origin is krn-works/krn; the lead fixed journal.json by hand before the pr stage (.krn/runs/lead/pr-head-wait/).
Proof: an observer where the stub origin URL is https://github.com/o/r.git and --repo x/r exits 64 with no git worktree add call.
Lead trap: pass --repo as the owner/repo of `git remote get-url origin` (krn-works/krn); a wrong slug already in the journal is fixed in .krn/runs/slice/<task>/journal.json before the pr stage.
